Here is a little userscript for power users who want to flip through subverses or the front page using the keyboard only. You can use the left/right arraow keys or the b/n keys to go to the previous/next page. I find it useful and maybe you do, too.

How to install:

1. Install Tampermonkey or a compatible userscript manager in your browser.

2. Create a new script and paste the code below into it.

3. Save and reload Voat.

// ==UserScript==
// @name Easy page flipping for Voat
// @include https://voat.co/*
// @version 1.0
// @description Flip through the Voat front page by using the left/right arrow keys or the keys b(ack)/n(ext).
// @author rinnsal
// @match http://*/*
// @grant none
// @require https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.4.1/jquery.min.js
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
 'use strict';

 document.onkeydown = function(e){
 if(document.activeElement === $("#q")[0]) {
 // do nothing if search field is focused
 return;
 }
 else {
 if(e.key == 'b' || e.key == 'ArrowLeft') {
 prevPage();
 };
 if(e.key == 'n' || e.key == 'ArrowRight') {
 nextPage();
 }
 }
 }
})();

function nextPage() {
 $(".btn-whoaverse-paging a:contains(next)")[0].click();
}

function prevPage() {
 $(".btn-whoaverse-paging a:contains(prev)")[0].click();
}
